name: scrapecreators
description: Read-only access to 27+ social platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Reddit, Pinterest, Threads, etc.) for profile, post, comment, audience, and transcript data. Authoritative source for everything Maya knows about a creator's public footprint.

tools.name: tiktok_profile
tools.description: Fetch a TikTok creator's profile (bio, follower count, verified status, bio link).

tools.name: tiktok_user_posts
tools.description: Fetch a TikTok creator's most recent videos with public metrics.

tools.name: tiktok_post
tools.description: Fetch a single TikTok post's metadata + metrics.

tools.name: tiktok_comments
tools.description: Fetch comments on a TikTok post (sorted by API default).

tools.name: tiktok_transcript
tools.description: Fetch the auto-generated transcript of a TikTok video.

tools.name: tiktok_comment_replies
tools.description: Fetch replies to a TikTok comment.

tools.name: tiktok_audience
tools.description: Fetch TikTok audience demographics for a public creator. Expensive endpoint; warn before use.

tools.name: tiktok_live
tools.description: Fetch current TikTok live stream data for a public creator.

tools.name: tiktok_following
tools.description: Fetch public TikTok accounts followed by a creator.

tools.name: tiktok_followers
tools.description: Fetch public TikTok followers for a creator.

tools.name: tiktok_search_users
tools.description: Search TikTok users by keyword.

tools.name: tiktok_search_hashtag
tools.description: Search TikTok videos by hashtag.

tools.name: tiktok_search_keyword
tools.description: Search TikTok videos by keyword.

tools.name: tiktok_search_top
tools.description: Search TikTok top results across videos and photo posts.

tools.name: tiktok_trending_feed
tools.description: Fetch TikTok trending feed for a region.

tools.name: tiktok_popular_videos
tools.description: Fetch popular TikTok videos.

tools.name: tiktok_popular_creators
tools.description: Fetch popular TikTok creators.

tools.name: tiktok_popular_hashtags
tools.description: Fetch popular TikTok hashtags.

tools.name: tiktok_popular_songs
tools.description: Fetch popular TikTok songs.

tools.name: tiktok_song
tools.description: Fetch TikTok song details by clip id.

tools.name: tiktok_song_videos
tools.description: Fetch TikTok videos using a song by clip id.

tools.name: instagram_profile
tools.description: Fetch an Instagram user's profile (bio, follower / following counts, verified, external URL).

tools.name: instagram_user_posts
tools.description: Fetch an Instagram user's most recent posts.

tools.name: instagram_post
tools.description: Fetch a single Instagram post by shortcode.

tools.name: youtube_channel
tools.description: Fetch a YouTube channel's profile (subscriber count, video count, description).

tools.name: youtube_channel_videos
tools.description: Fetch a YouTube channel's recent videos.

tools.name: youtube_video
tools.description: Fetch a single YouTube video by id.

tools.name: linkedin_profile
tools.description: Fetch a LinkedIn profile (headline, summary, follower count, connection count).

tools.name: linkedin_posts
tools.description: Fetch a LinkedIn user's recent posts.

tools.name: twitter_profile
tools.description: Fetch an X / Twitter profile (followers, bio, verified).

tools.name: twitter_user_tweets
tools.description: Fetch an X / Twitter user's recent tweets.
